name: equilibrium_relevant_mass
provenance: Hand-built multiple-equilibrium matrix for MATH-14 (docs/ASCENSION_TRIALS_KIRO_IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC_V1_1.md §15 MATH-14, §11.4). Row payoff M = [[1,-1],[-1,1],[0,0],[-2,-2]] is a symmetric-value game with value 0. The optimal row-strategy polytope is {x >= 0, sum x = 1, x^T M >= 0}: the two ineqs give x0 - x1 - 2*x3 >= 0 and x1 - x0 - 2*x3 >= 0, whose sum forces x3 = 0 and then x0 = x1. Hence the maximum mass each strategy can carry in an optimum is x0 <= 1/2, x1 <= 1/2, x2 <= 1 (the pure point (0,0,1,0) is optimal), and x3 = 0. With the 1% threshold, E^0.01 = {s0, s1, s2} and s3 is excluded. These are exact rational values derived analytically from the matrix, not reverse-engineered from engine output (REQ-9.4).
